name: Squoosh Bench: Evaluating UX-1 on 318 Historical Website A/B Tests
title: Squoosh Bench: Evaluating UX-1 on 318 Historical Website A/B Tests
summary: Experimentation teams must decide which proposed website changes to test with live traffic. We evaluated whether forecasts from simulated shoppers could inform that choice. We screened 412 historical website A/B tests and evaluated four systems on the 318 that ran longer than 21 days. Each system predicted an original win, a variant win, or an inconclusive result. Page roles were masked and record
